title: Pasta's Server-side Cobblemon Experience v2
description: A smaller version of the main modpack containing only the things necessary to run it on a server. This is for v2.
body:
# DETAILED DESCRIPTION

This is the server version of [Pasta's Cobblemon Experience v2](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pastas-cobblemon-experience-v2). This one trims out the fat by removing mods that doesn't have any serverside functionality or that simply prevents the server from launching when present.

This one is only meant for installing the main modpack on a server. It can be played in singleplayer, but it will be missing out on features. I would recommend the server to have at least 8GB of RAM to perform well, but you may need more depending on the amount of players you expect to have.

A couple of mods/settings are disabled by default for maximum performance on a server, enable them at your own risk.
- Biomes O' Plenty: All nether biomes are toggled off in the mod's config due to server strainage.
- Dismount Entity: Blocks you from riding your friends's Pokémon when enabled.
- Tectonic: Big performance cost, made chunks load too slowly on my server.

Since all mods and datapacks in this version is also in the client version, I refer to the client's modpage for a list of all mods included. This also goes for screenshots of the modpack and the credit for the thumbnail; it's all on the main page.
